I would count all calories, including gum, always making sure to round up and I only ate 300 calories a day. Was it healthy? Nope. Did I die after two days? Obviously not. In fact, after a relatively short amount of time, hunger went away and a nice high set in. I eventually ended up in the hospital then a rehab, but that took quite a long time. This notion people have of "if I skip a meal I'll gain weight" or "if I skip a meal I'll damage my metabolism" is just ridiculous. It's nothing more than an excuse for them to relinquish themselves of any guilt for being a fat pig.

This whole fallacy of "muh starvation mode" has really gotten out of control.
